Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic...

Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start…

The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?
A charismatic newcomer, Dr. Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?
Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.

Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.
Doctor Ziggurat demonstrates the power of the Spiral Force.
Gingka and his friends chase Dr. Ziggurat to a flying Hades City.
Gingka and his friends battle towards the Spiral Core in Hades City.
Tsubasa defeats Jack in Hades City.
Kyoya defeats Damian, while Masamune and Gingka reach the Spiral Core.
Masamune and Gingka defeat Faust at the Spiral Core.
Sabrina wishes she had a pet. Oh, Salem’s okay as a pal, but as a loving furball, he doesn’t cut it.
There’s a dog show in Greendale. Cassandra has a stunning entry. Margaux and Tiffany are helping her train and show it.
Sabrina agrees to help Maritza with her science project but oversleeps and forgets. At the witches’ academy, Sabrina and Cassandra meet a very frank magic mirror who insults and infuriates Cassandra.
While shopping with Sabrina, Maritza ogles a necklace that Cassandra buys. Knowing how much Maritza wants it, the unkind young witch uses it to taunt Maritza.
Sabrina and Cassandra bicker their way through another potion-making assignment at the witches’ academy. Their arguing causes them to spill the entire vial of Salvia Muscaria: an extremely rare herb!
Evil monsters from a virtual reality game break out and materialize in Riverdale!
Veronica doesn't think that Archie dotes on her enough, so she visits a witch woman who gives her a magic potion.
Moose is close to being cut from the football team unless he is able to bring his grades up.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Cleo is failing at school and is assigned a tutor - Charlotte. Cleo wants Lewis back but her attitude to Charlotte only drives him further away. Cleo discovers Lewis and Charlotte kissing.
An artistic girl's sketches take on a life of their own. Realizing her capability, she attempts to draw the perfect family.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
When Buddy and Vince skip school one too many times to play their favourite video arcade game "Monster Attack", they find themselves magically transformed into a real life version of the game.

Kristin drives out to a small fishing community to investigate a local sighting of a sea monster. / Sixteen year old Simon's fascination with spiders becomes a nightmare when his turn of the century town is infested with arachnids of every variety.
Ten year old Jimmy is afraid to sleep in the dark. / While digging in Greece, a greedy Fortune Hunter searches out the ancient cave ruins of the Greek legend Medusa.

After Samantha, Gus and Verne save a magical carpet from Zarlak, they've got to go back to their least favorite class at the Enchanted School -- Magical Histories, taught by their least favorite teacher -- the dull and boring Mr. Sternwand.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.
Archie has a series of extremely pleasant dreams about a beautiful girl who adores him.
A new girl arrives at school and quickly catches Archie's attention.

'Panthergeist': The Panther is assigned to remove a fastidious ghost from a castle. 'Pinky's Pending Pink Slip': The Panther has to think up new ways to teach biology to a problem student without the Principal catching him breaking the rules.

'The Three Pink Porkers': The Panther's bed and breakfast is besieged by a trio of pigs that go hog-wild. 'The Heart of Pinkness': The Panther must make sure one of his river boat passengers isn't eaten by the legendary Varkzan of the jungle.
Robotnik unleashes his "Stupidity Ray"on Mobius. As Sonic and Tails make their way to Robotnik's new lair, the Pinball Fortress they find themselves competing with Wes Weasely and Sergeant Doberman.
Robotnik threatens to demolish an airport, a lighthouse, and a train station. Sonic is forced to travel to all three places in order to remove the bombs.

Robotnik uses his Robo-Matic Machine to construct a pushy robot coach from a football called Coachnik by placing playbooks, game films, strategies, plenty of grit, nerves of steel , and a 300 lb. ham into the Robo-Matic Machine.
Sonic comes to the rescue of a town that is held for ransom by Robotnik's crime syndicate. A few scenes from the pilot animation are integrated into this episode.
Inspector Gadget foils an M.A.D. plot to kidnap the Shah of Freeland for ransom.
Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Chief Quimby locate and destroy a secret device of M.A.D. that melts metal.

His landlady smells a fish when Mr. Bean gets a bird. Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper.

Sunbathing proves a more strenuous pursuit for Mr. Bean. It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather.

Mr. Bean forgets his teddy’s Birthday - then gives him a treat to remember. Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind.
Mr. Bean loses control of a pest and makes a mountain out of a molehill. Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn.
Mr. Bean is driven to distraction by diabolical decibels. Mr. Bean’s tranquillity is shattered by deafening roadworks outside his bedroom window.

Cyril inherits an Irish castle, where water from the Well of Doon is said to cure all ailments. To preserve the well for the inhabitants of the city, Cyril has to fight against an inheritance claim of rich businessman, Ron Blackard.
When a disgruntled employee steals an ancient Dragon Flute from a Toronto Museum, he uses its legendary powers to render crowds of people unconscious.
Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh'lainn Blaze...
